scripts.text:
TRUNCATE TABLE d360.STG_EDS_DID_PRODUCTGROUPING_SELECT_SRC;

INSERT INTO d360.STG_EDS_DID_PRODUCTGROUPING_SELECT_SRC
(
BANK_CODE
,SOURCE_CODE
,PRODUCT_GROUP
,PRODUCT_TYPE
,PRODUCT_DESCRIPTION
,PRODUCT_GROUP_BPMD
,PRODUCT_GROUP_RBB
,PRODUCT_GROUP_FPAD
,CURRENCY
,APPLICATION
,NIM_FPAD
,FILE_NAME
,JSRC_FLG
,JTAR_FLG 
)

	SELECT 
    BANK_CODE
    ,SOURCE_CODE
    ,PRODUCT_GROUP
    ,PRODUCT_TYPE
    ,PRODUCT_DESCRIPTION
    ,PRODUCT_GROUP_BPMD
    ,PRODUCT_GROUP_RBB
    ,PRODUCT_GROUP_FPAD
    ,CURRENCY
    ,APPLICATION
	,NIM_FPAD
	,FILE_NAME
	,1 AS JSRC_FLG
	,0 AS JTAR_FLG
	FROM d360.STG_EDS_DID_PRODUCTGROUPING
	WHERE H = 'D';


INSERT INTO d360.STG_EDS_DID_PRODUCTGROUPING_SELECT_SRC
(
BANK_CODE
,SOURCE_CODE
,PRODUCT_GROUP
,PRODUCT_TYPE
,PRODUCT_DESCRIPTION
,PRODUCT_GROUP_BPMD
,PRODUCT_GROUP_RBB
,PRODUCT_GROUP_FPAD
,CURRENCY
,APPLICATION
,NIM_FPAD
,FILE_NAME
,JSRC_FLG
,JTAR_FLG 
)
	SELECT
    BANK_CODE
    ,SOURCE_CODE
    ,PRODUCT_GROUP
    ,PRODUCT_TYPE
    ,PRODUCT_DESCRIPTION
    ,PRODUCT_GROUP_BPMD
    ,PRODUCT_GROUP_RBB
    ,PRODUCT_GROUP_FPAD
    ,CURRENCY
    ,APPLICATION
	,NIM_FPAD
	,FILE_NAME
	,0 AS JSRC_FLG
	,1 AS JTAR_FLG 
	FROM EDS.DID_PRODUCTGROUPING CC
	WHERE CC.ISLATEST = '1';


TRUNCATE TABLE d360.STG_EDS_DID_PRODUCTGROUPING_GROUP_SRC;

INSERT INTO d360.STG_EDS_DID_PRODUCTGROUPING_GROUP_SRC
(
BANK_CODE
,SOURCE_CODE
,PRODUCT_GROUP
,PRODUCT_TYPE
,PRODUCT_DESCRIPTION
,PRODUCT_GROUP_BPMD
,PRODUCT_GROUP_RBB
,PRODUCT_GROUP_FPAD
,CURRENCY
,APPLICATION
,NIM_FPAD
,FILE_NAME
,JSRC_FLG_CNT
,JTAR_FLG_CNT
,FILE_DATE
)

	SELECT 
    BANK_CODE
    ,SOURCE_CODE
    ,PRODUCT_GROUP
    ,PRODUCT_TYPE
    ,PRODUCT_DESCRIPTION
    ,PRODUCT_GROUP_BPMD
    ,PRODUCT_GROUP_RBB
    ,PRODUCT_GROUP_FPAD
    ,CURRENCY
    ,APPLICATION
	,NIM_FPAD
	,FILE_NAME
	,JSRC_FLG_CNT
	,JTAR_FLG_CNT
	,CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME , 12), 8) AS DATE) FILE_DATE
	FROM 
		(
		SELECT
        BANK_CODE
        ,SOURCE_CODE
        ,PRODUCT_GROUP
        ,PRODUCT_TYPE
        ,PRODUCT_DESCRIPTION
        ,PRODUCT_GROUP_BPMD
        ,PRODUCT_GROUP_RBB
        ,PRODUCT_GROUP_FPAD
        ,CURRENCY
        ,APPLICATION
		,NIM_FPAD
		,MAX(FILE_NAME) FILE_NAME
		,SUM(JSRC_FLG) AS JSRC_FLG_CNT
		,SUM(JTAR_FLG) AS JTAR_FLG_CNT
		FROM d360.STG_EDS_DID_PRODUCTGROUPING_SELECT_SRC
			GROUP BY 
            BANK_CODE
            ,SOURCE_CODE
            ,PRODUCT_GROUP
            ,PRODUCT_TYPE
            ,PRODUCT_DESCRIPTION
            ,PRODUCT_GROUP_BPMD
            ,PRODUCT_GROUP_RBB
            ,PRODUCT_GROUP_FPAD
            ,CURRENCY
            ,APPLICATION
			,NIM_FPAD
			HAVING ( SUM(JSRC_FLG) > 0 AND SUM(JTAR_FLG) = 0 ) OR ( SUM(JSRC_FLG) = 0 AND SUM(JTAR_FLG) = 1) 
		) AS TEMP


DECLARE @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY AS DATE
SELECT @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY = PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY FROM EDS.DATE_DIM 
WHERE FULLDATE = @DATETOPROCESS;	


UPDATE A
SET
SCD_END_DATE = @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY
, ISLATEST = 0
FROM EDS.DID_PRODUCTGROUPING A 
INNER JOIN d360.STG_EDS_DID_PRODUCTGROUPING_GROUP_SRC B 
ON COALESCE(A.BANK_CODE,'-1') = COALESCE(B.BANK_CODE,'-1')
AND COALESCE(A.SOURCE_CODE,'-1') = COALESCE(B.SOURCE_CODE,'-1')
AND COALESCE(A.PRODUCT_TYPE,'-1') = COALESCE(B.PRODUCT_TYPE,'-1')
AND A.ISLATEST = 1
AND B.JTAR_FLG_CNT = 1


INSERT INTO EDS.DID_PRODUCTGROUPING
(
BANK_CODE
,SOURCE_CODE
,PRODUCT_GROUP
,PRODUCT_TYPE
,PRODUCT_DESCRIPTION
,PRODUCT_GROUP_BPMD
,PRODUCT_GROUP_RBB
,PRODUCT_GROUP_FPAD
,CURRENCY
,APPLICATION
,NIM_FPAD
,SCD_START_DATE
,SCD_END_DATE
,ISACTIVE
,ISLATEST
,BNK_CODE
,FILE_NAME
,insert_dttm
)
	SELECT
    BANK_CODE
    ,SOURCE_CODE
    ,PRODUCT_GROUP
    ,PRODUCT_TYPE
    ,PRODUCT_DESCRIPTION
    ,PRODUCT_GROUP_BPMD
    ,PRODUCT_GROUP_RBB
    ,PRODUCT_GROUP_FPAD
    ,CURRENCY
    ,APPLICATION
	,NIM_FPAD
	,@DATETOPROCESS
	,'9999-12-31'
	,1
	,1
	,SRC.BANK_CODE
	,SRC.FILE_NAME
	,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
	FROM d360.STG_EDS_DID_PRODUCTGROUPING_GROUP_SRC SRC
	WHERE JSRC_FLG_CNT >0
